text:
emma: quick check: the runtime quickstart references `https://internal-artifacts.redwood/guides/runtime-latest.tar.gz` and in staging the curl returns 403. caught in a smoke-run.

navid: can you paste the exact curl output? might be a bucket ACL or signed-url expiry.

emma: sure:
```
$ curl -I https://internal-artifacts.redwood/guides/runtime-latest.tar.gz
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-request-id: rwt-55e2
```
I can pull it from the artifact console when logged in, so likely a public vs internal ACL mismatch.

navid: ack. I'll ask infra to look at bucket policy, but that might take a few hours. Can we land a docs-side fallback so staging previews and CI don't break?

emma: yes if we add a CDN fallback URL inline and a short note with checksum that points to `https://cdn.redwood.com/runtime/runtime-2025-quickstart.tar.gz` (cdn returns 200 for me). Also add a tiny conditional note: "If internal artifact 403s, use CDN link".

yuki: @emma can you file the PR and request quick review? i18n owners prefer the fallback included so translators can mirror it. We'll need a ja backport after merge.

emma: will do. PR checklist I'm planning:
- replace primary URL in docs/quickstart/runtime.md with the internal-artifacts link still first
- add a parenthetical fallback CDN link with its sha256 checksum
- add a one-line note in the guide about why the fallback exists
- add a CI smoke step to `.github/workflows/smoke.yml`: `curl -f $ASSET_URL || curl -f $CDN_FALLBACK`

infra-bot: New ticket created: INFRA-2481 (s3: public access policy evaluation). Assigned to @navid. ETA: 6h.

navid: filed INFRA-2481 and pinged storage team. I'll follow up once they confirm policy change or give guidance for signed URL TTL.

emma: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12678  includes fallback, checksum `sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924`, and the CI tweak. @yuki please review.

yuki: taking a look. A couple of nit picks: can we put the fallback in an HTML comment so rendered pages don't show the alternate prominently, but translators still see it? otherwise fine. Also request ja backport once merged.

emma: good call. I'll move it into an HTML comment and add `<!-- i18n: please mirror fallback link in ja/ -->`.

docs-bot: Auto-detected asset access error. Created DOCS-5012. Suggested changelog entry: "fix: quickstart asset fallback (staging ACL)"

yuki: LGTM on the comment approach. Approving review now.

emma: merged and cherry-picked to `translations/ja/quickstart/runtime.md` with a note to the i18n owners.

emma: post-merge smoke: ran `.github/workflows/smoke.yml` locally and validated that the workflow tries the internal URL then falls back to CDN when the internal returns 403. smoke run exit code 0.

avid: storage team applied a policy tweak; INFRA-2481 updated to "monitor". They said the internal artifact link should return 200 by tomorrow morning.

yuki: great, thanks all. I'll add a line in the runbook about the temporary fallback and that infra will revert once policy stabilizes.

emma: :thumbsup: closing the loop here. If anyone sees the staging preview show the fallback comment (shouldn't render), ping me.
